action.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-05' THEN debit - credit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-04' THEN debit - credit ELSE 0 END) AS growth FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'US01' AND period IN ('2026-04','2026-05') AND account_id >= '6000' AND account_id < '7000' GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id FROM m ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 1
